profile.headline: Cloud Software Engineer at Hewlett Packard Enterprise
profile.summary:
I am a software developer with a breadth of experience in different industries and toolsets with over 7 years in systems, cloud, automation, and embedded environments.

I have a deep interest in backend systems, going behind the scenes to uncover what makes a platform, service, or application work.

I love learning new skills and technologies. I am most proficient in Python and Go, but have experience in C, Javascript, and others.

I am passionate about the non-technical aspects of software development. Believe it or not, I actually look forward to meetings for opportunities to problem-solve as a team. I take pride in clear, concise communication on tickets, pull requests, documentation, and release notes.

Outside of work, I am a semi-serious hobbyist game developer. I am currently working on my first official release -- a mobile 2D puzzle game inspired by the Rubix cube.

positions.title: Cloud Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Durham, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed software for the Devices team to provide executable agents for Linux, macOS, and Windows, as well as the backend services that interface with the agents and allow IT professionals to administer them.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Software Development · Kubernetes · Docker · Cloud Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Systems Engineering · Git · Microservices

positions.title: Software Configuration Management Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software and utilizing Dev Ops tools to manage and improve the development, build, and test environments for the local app development team. My major projects and responsibilities included:
- Leading a project to automate app metrics collection and analysis with Python and visualizing trends with MatPlotLib.
- Creating automated tools with Python to validate apps are packaged correctly, monitor the team’s GitHub API usage, identify items by Jira on the dev branch waiting to come to master, etc.
- Managing monthly app release builds in Jenkins, integrating cherry picks, and solving merge conflicts.
- Resolving configuration and build issues in Jenkins and GitHub in Linux and Windows spaces.

positions.title: Engineering Leadership Development Program - Marketing Coordinator
positions.description: I supported the sales team in the Canada region by coordinating their efforts at trade shows and events. I handled the ordering and delivery of trade show equipment and promotional items, as well as coordinated dates and related hospitality events. I also provided marketing assistance to the sales team by supplying them with marketing materials and services.

positions.title: Engineering Leadership Development Program - Embedded Software Developer
positions.description: I supported the Global Technologies Development team and completed two key projects. First, I created a prototype web-based user interface used to configure a line of embedded systems. Next, I created a scale tester for an electric meter that used the Raspberry Pi in conjunction with a meter simulator to test up to 1000 virtual meters.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: I developed software in C on the Fitness Wearables team. I helped develop, test, and debug products before they came to market. Most notably, I developed and updated the UI for the Garmin integrated smartwatch, the vívomove HR.

positions.title: Test Engineering Co-op
positions.description: I provided test engineering for large computer data storage systems at EMC Corporation in Apex, NC. My responsibilities included analyzing quality and test data for trends, performing failure analysis on systems, installing and maintaining test equipment, generating test documentation, and assisting production through failure isolation.

projects.title: Head to Head Hockey - NHL team comparison website
projects.description:
Basic single-page webapp I made to get a better grasp of the VueJS framework, as well as the Vuetify component library. Plus, I like hockey.

This webapp gets data from an official NHL API and compares stats between teams of the user's choosing, as well as creating a simple graph of the results.

organizations.name: Engineers Without Borders USA - NCSU Chapter
organizations.description: I have been involved with the NCSU Chapter of Engineers Without Borders USA (EWB) since my first semester. EWB is a national nonprofit organization which partners with developing communities all around the world. As a member of EWB, I work on a project with other members of my chapter designing a renewable energy system for a remote school in Freetown, Sierra Leone. In addition to designing a solar panel system to help power the school, it is also our goal to assist the faculty of the school by providing additional educational materials, mainly focused on the basics of STEM education and different forms of renewable energy.

organizations.name: Engineers Without Borders USA - NCSU Chapter
organizations.description: I became the Administration Director in January of 2016. As an officer of my local chapter, I help lead the organization by managing some of the logistics like recording our meeting minutes and updating the mailing list for the chapter. Along with the other officers, I help make important decisions regarding the chapter as a whole.
